applies_to: Panasonic KW9M (AKW91110) with the Modbus RTU protocol selected, user manual WUME-KW9M-10.
summary: The KW9M is a compact energy monitor that measures up to three single-phase circuits or one three-phase system and speaks MEWTOCOL, Modbus RTU or DL/T645 on RS485. In Modbus mode everything is a holding register read with function 03 and written with 06/16. This map covers the comm and metering settings, per-circuit and total energy, power, voltage, current, frequency, power factor, demand, THD and the conversion (cost) values.

addressing.note: The Modbus table prints hex register numbers (0064H). That number goes straight into the request: the manual's example reads conversion rate 005DH with start address 005DH. Each Modbus address equals the MEWTOCOL DT number converted to hex (DT00100 = 0064H).

source.title: KW9M Eco-POWER METER User's Manual
source.pages: Section 7.4 MODBUS (RTU), manual pp. 66-76 (PDF pp. 73-83); MEWTOCOL table pp. 57-62 used to cross-check names

notes: Word order: each 32-bit value is printed as two rows marked <LSB> (lower address) and <MSB> (higher address), so the low word comes first (CDAB). The manual's footnote calls these 'byte', but each mark sits on a whole 16-bit register.
The manual heads the measurement table 'Data registers for 3P3W'. For three-phase systems use the Total power and Average frequency / PF registers, as the manual says.
Per-circuit integral (energy) registers can be written with function 16 (e.g. to zero them, as in the manual's example at 0064H); totals are read-only.

The settings table text is laid out in two separate columns in the PDF; register-to-name pairing was checked against the MEWTOCOL DT list, where the DT number in decimal equals the Modbus hex address.

Demand measurement status (75F8H): the Modbus table codes 0 = Start, 1 = Stop, but the MEWTOCOL table for the same setting codes 0 = Stop, 1 = Start. Value meanings are left out until checked on a live meter.
Not included: logging data and any registers not listed in section 7.4.2. Registers not listed read 0.

integration.summary: Set the meter's protocol to MODBUS (MODr) on the front panel, then read holding registers with function 03: total active power 0092H, total import kWh 006AH, voltages from 00A4H and currents from 00B4H. All 32-bit values are low word first.
integration.enable: Protocol defaults to MEWTOCOL. Select MODr (Modbus RTU) in the communication setting mode, or write 1 to register 0062H. Changing protocol resets device number, speed, format, stop bit and response time.
quirks: Only data bits 8 work with Modbus RTU; parity default is odd (8b-o).
Writes outside the allowed range, or to a missing address, are acknowledged but ignored.
Maximum 26 registers per read and 23 per write.
setup: Defaults: device number 1, 19200 bps, 8 data bits, odd parity, 1 stop bit, response time 5 ms.
Modbus device numbers 1-247; broadcast address 0 gets no reply.
Set phase/wire, CT type and CT primary current to match the wiring or readings will be wrong.
gotchas: Settings written over Modbus go straight to non-volatile memory; avoid writing them cyclically.
Most values exist twice: a 0.01-resolution block from 0064H and a 0.001-resolution block from 00C6H. Check which block you poll before scaling.
